description: Analyze preload script and main process IPC code for security issues. Checks for: raw ipcRenderer exposure, missing sender validation, synchronous IPC usage, listener memory leaks, prototype pollution via contextBridge, and insecure channel patterns. Provide the actual code content to analyze.

preloadCode.description: Content of the preload script (preload.ts/js) to analyze

rendererCode.description: Content of renderer code that uses IPC, to check for anti-patterns
